The other products in the consideration set, including the GAMDIAS Hermes E2, GK GAMAKAY LK67, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, and G.SKILL KM360, are also high-quality mechanical keyboards but may not offer the exact combination of features and value that the customer is looking for.
